<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="tNAFsRNgOfjXv_mc5o17"> <mxGraphModel dx="1422" dy="572" grid="1" gridSize="5" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml use-case-place-and-pay
left to right direction
skinparam packageStyle rectangle

actor \"Khách hàng\" as Customer
actor \"Mock payment gateway\" as Payment <<system>>

rectangle \"BrewLite System\" {
 usecase \"Đặt và thanh toán\nđơn hàng\" as UC_Order
 usecase \"Xử lý thanh toán\nmô phỏng\" as UC_Pay

 usecase \"Áp mã khuyến mãi\n(mở rộng)\" as UC_Promo
 usecase \"Đổi điểm giảm giá\n(mở rộng)\" as UC_Redeem
 usecase \"Tích điểm thưởng\n(mở rộng)\" as UC_Earn
 usecase \"Hủy đơn\n(mở rộng)\" as UC_Cancel
}

Customer -- UC_Order
UC_Pay -- Payment

UC_Order .> UC_Pay : <<include>>
UC_Promo .> UC_Order : <<extend>>
UC_Redeem .> UC_Order : <<extend>>
UC_Earn .> UC_Pay : <<extend>>
UC_Cancel .> UC_Order : <<extend>>
@enduml",
 "config": null
